notes: The app looks for its own update as it opens and shows what is new before anything else
The set-up screen now ticks each step by itself and carries on the moment the game folder opens
It shows the exact row to look for in your phone's own settings list, next to the button that opens it
Permissions are asked from a bar at the bottom, so nothing locks the screen - and a button that is waiting always comes back
The app opens and works whether or not Shizuku is running - only adding files waits for it
A pack that has several builds is one row - open it to see every version and its size
